title: Manasi-Thulasimathi Assure India of Para Badminton Medal
indian_angle: Manasi and Thulasimathi have guaranteed India a medal in para badminton by reaching the semifinals.
summary: Manasi and Thulasimathi secured India a medal in para badminton by advancing to the semifinals, as both losing semifinalists are awarded bronze.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee will give Indian players a stronger voice in the sport's administration.
summary: Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to provide a direct channel for players' representation and welfare.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Underway
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare Indian junior shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Conducts Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is vital for enhancing the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur, focusing on upgrading coaching expertise from September 14th to 23rd.

title: New Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: New regulations have been released for the Inter State Team Championships, a key domestic event for Indian players to compete and gain experience.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participation.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp prepares young Indian shuttlers for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, aiming to nurture future international talent.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
